svg.aria-label: The GV100 die. Six GPCs of 14 SMs each, 80 of the 84 SMs switched on, sit around one 6 MB L2 cache shared by every SM, with the host interface and GigaThread engine on top and a high-speed hub below. Four HBM2 stacks sit on the sides. A chip has three exits, counting both directions, from L2 to HBM2 at about 900 GB/s, from the hub to 6 NVLink ports at 300 GB/s, and from the host interface to PCIe 3.0 at about 32 GB/s.
